name: trace-marker-report
description: The marker report restricted to the trace markers — one row per traced point, in the same tab-delimited column set as the full marker report.
notes: Columns match the marker report through `Type`; the trace report has no `TensileStrength` column.
`filename` is accepted although the engine's own `massflow marker trace-report ?` enumeration does not list it.
official_documentation: Read back from the file the command writes; the command page documents no columns.
